I booked the room through OYO at a confirmed price, but when I reached the hotel, the receptionist denied my check-in saying the booking amount was too low. He demanded three times the booked price and behaved very rudely. The staff was completely mannerless and unprofessional. OYO should take strict action against such properties. Highly disappointed — not recommended at all.

I had booked a hotel online, but when I arrived, they refused to give me a room. I told them I had already paid 25%, but they simply said, “ysha room nahi hai.” They didn’t even refund my 25% payment. Instead, they shifted me to another hotel, which was absolutely terrible, it was in a deserted location, the rooms were dirty and there were things that definitely shouldn’t have been there 😅. The bedsheets had filthy stains and they didn’t even bother to change them. Since it was already late at night, I had no choice but to stay and I had to pay extra charges for that hotel as well. In the end, I lost my advance payment and had to book another unsafe and awful hotel. Honestly, it was a horrible experience and I would strongly advise against booking hotels like this, whether online or offline
